description: Suggests up to 8 Brazilian companies for a CNPJ, company name, partner, phone or e-mail, ordered by how well they match. It does not count against the daily free limit and does not show contacts. `incompleto` means one of the sources did not answer.

q.description: A name of 3 to 120 characters, a CNPJ, a phone with area code or a full e-mail.
